_about: What each job description in uploads/01_new_role actually says, as the New Role step 2 shows it. The prototype reads the same content from src/data/roleLibrary.ts by file name; it is not in the merged db.

findings.text: Confirms 8 of your 9 areas: plan, prioritization, budgets, cost and forecast, schedule, rate cases, close-out and reporting.
findings.quote: “Maintains the capital plan, tracks cost and forecast for every project and supports rate case filings with capital schedules.”

findings.text: Add a task to Cost tracking and forecasting: review contractor claims and change order requests before WIN approval.
findings.quote: “Reviews contractor claims and change order requests against the contract before they go to WIN approval.”
findings.value: Review contractor claims and change order requests before WIN approval

findings.text: Take Grant and loan compliance out of scope. Treasury prepares SRF and WIFIA draws and keeps the compliance records.
findings.quote: “SRF and WIFIA draws and their compliance records are prepared by Treasury; the analyst supplies eligible spend on request.”

findings.text: Set the threshold on Forecast variance: over 10% on a large project, or over $250,000, needs a written explanation.
findings.quote: §4.2 “A large project whose forecast exceeds its approved budget by more than 10%, or by more than $250,000, needs a written variance explanation.”
findings.value: Over 10% on a large project, or over $250,000

findings.text: Add a routine: monthly test-year in-service check for Marc Beaulieu while a rate case is open.
findings.quote: “While a rate case is open, confirms each month that projects claimed in the test year remain on track to be in service.”

routine.name: Test-year in-service check
routine.cadence: Monthly, while a rate case is open

findings.text: Add Sofia Lindqvist to the people it works for. The description says the analyst hands the plan workbook to Capital Planning.
findings.quote: “Works with the Senior Analyst, Capital Planning on each plan vintage.”

findings.text: Confirms 4 of your areas: rate cases, data requests, compliance filings and riders.
findings.quote: “Prepares revenue requirement schedules and responds to data requests.”

findings.text: Add a task to Compliance filings: prepare the annual service quality report.
findings.quote: “Prepares the annual service quality report for each commission.”
findings.value: Prepare the annual service quality report

findings.quote: “Monitors inventory, supplier performance and chemical supply.”

findings.value: Collect BABA certifications for funded orders

findings.quote: “Prepares the O&M budget, monthly variance analysis and management reports.”
